title: Prohibition of Anger
arabic_text: عنْ [أبي هُريرةَ] رَضِي اللهُ عَنْهُ، (أنَّ رَجُلاً قالَ للنَّبيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: أَوْصِني. قالَ: "لاَ تَغْضَبْ." فَرَدَّدَ مِرارًا، قالَ: "لاَ تَغْضَبْ").
english_translation: From Abū Hurayrah (raḍiyallāhu ʿanhu) that a man said to the Prophet (ṣallallāhu ʿalayhi wasallam), 'Advise me.' He said, 'Do not become angry' and (the man) repeated his request a number of times and he said, 'Do not become angry.'
description: This Hadith recounts an incident where a man sought advice from the Prophet Muhammad, and the Prophet repeatedly instructed him, 'Do not become angry.' The hadith emphasizes the importance of controlling one's anger.
